## Purpose and Runtime
Voxy is a Java/Fabric client mod that adds level-of-detail (LoD) rendering to Minecraft. It is packaged as a Gradle project (`build.gradle`) with Fabric metadata and Mixins (`src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json`, `src/main/resources/client.voxy.mixins.json`). Runtime behavior is embedded into the Minecraft client rather than exposed as a web/service application.

## Client Lifecycle and Integration Entry Points
Client orchestration is centered on `VoxyClient`, per-world/client instance management, and session event hooks. Mixins inject Voxy into Minecraft rendering, chunk-cache, world, packet/session, and task execution paths.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/VoxyClient.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/VoxyClientInstance.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/mixin/minecraft/MixinLevelRenderer.java`

Compatibility boundaries exist for Sodium, Iris shaders, Nvidium, Flashback, and Chunky through dedicated mixin/adapter packages.

## World Ingest, Voxelization, and LoD State
Minecraft world/chunk data is converted into voxelized sections, then maintained by a world engine that tracks active sections and propagates updates across LoD levels. The `WorldUpdater` and service layer separate ingestion and persistence work from rendering.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/WorldEngine.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/WorldUpdater.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/voxelization/WorldConversionFactory.java`

Primary flow: Minecraft chunk/world hooks → voxel conversion → `WorldEngine` section state → mip/mapper processing → render-data generation and/or storage.

## Persistence and Import Boundary
Section data is saved/loaded through configurable serialization and storage abstractions. Backends include in-memory storage, LMDB, RocksDB, and Redis; adapters add compression, caching, fragmentation, and delegation. Existing worlds or external LoD data can be imported.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/SaveLoadSystem3.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/config/section/SectionSerializationStorage.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/commonImpl/ImportManager.java`

Material external infrastructure: local filesystem-backed databases (LMDB/RocksDB) and optionally a Redis service. Compression supports LZ4, LZMA, and Zstandard.

## Render Preparation and Geometry
World sections become renderable section data asynchronously. Render-distance tracking and update routing decide what must be built; geometry managers own CPU/GPU-ready geometry and buffer allocation.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/building/RenderGenerationService.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/SectionUpdateRouter.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/section/geometry/BasicAsyncGeometryManager.java`

The boundary is explicit: common world data is renderer-agnostic; client rendering packages transform it into GPU geometry.

## Visibility, Hierarchy, and Draw Submission
The renderer maintains hierarchical nodes and bounds for visibility/occlusion decisions, then submits visible section geometry through an MDIC section-rendering backend. Hi-Z/depth resources and compute shaders support GPU culling/traversal.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/hierachical/HierarchicalOcclusionTraverser.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/bounding/ChunkBoundStore.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/rendering/section/backend/mdic/MDICSectionRenderer.java`

## Render Pipeline and GPU Resources
`VoxyRenderSystem` selects normal or Iris-integrated pipelines, owns OpenGL resource lifecycles, and performs LoD/post-processing passes such as SSAO. GLSL resources include OpenGL 4.6 compute/draw shaders.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/VoxyRenderSystem.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/core/RenderPipelineFactory.java`
- `src/main/resources/assets/voxy/shaders/lod/gl46/cmdgen.comp`

The GPU boundary is wrapped by GL buffer, texture, framebuffer, fence, and shader abstractions under `client/core/gl`; GPU capability selection includes Windows-specific handling.

## Concurrency and Operational Controls
Background ingestion, saving, geometry generation, and node work are coordinated through shared services, thread pools, priority controls, and per-thread contexts. Client configuration, commands, debug entries, and statistics expose operational control and observability.
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/thread/ServiceManager.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/thread/UnifiedServiceThreadPool.java`
- `src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/client/config/VoxyConfig.java`
